executionResult.executionNotes: Removed unused storage and file URL permissions from both browser manifests and removed Chrome file host access. The extension now requests only downloads and contextMenus: one to save user-requested exports and one to open the viewer from a page context menu. Added a permission-purpose inventory and pre-release audit checklist.

verification.summary: All four extension flow tests passed, including assertions that both manifests request exactly downloads and contextMenus with no host or file access. The Chrome/Edge MV3 and Firefox MV2 packages rebuilt successfully.
